chunk_text: Rudra designation normally features in Soola Dasa to know the possible time of death. The Dasas of the Rasis are calculated in direct or reverse order according to the natal ascendant being odd or even. Soola Dasa calculations are akin to that of Sthira Dasa. But in the case of Sthira Dasa, Rudra's counterpart is Brahma Graha.
